newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.8 bln for Tuesday, March 18.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.8 bln for Tuesday, March 18.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, March 18 are expected to total $1.8 billion in 37 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $911 million in 14 sales, with a $316 million Palm Beach County, Fla., deal through Smith Barney topping the list.
On the competitive side, 23 sales totaling $865 million are on the schedule, a $525 million California deal at 1200 EST is the largest.
An additional four sales totaling $51 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
